en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a coastal bay with steep, barren hills surrounding a small seaside town. A curved beach with a pier and many small boats lines the shoreline. A steamship producing a plume of dark smoke is entering or leaving the harbor. Off the point at the right-hand side are a couple of prominent rocky islets near the mouth of the bay. In the lower left are several larger buildings and what appears to be a tent-like pavilion. A red printed number "6737." appears in the upper right corner on the sky area.
